art_direction: 短宽卵石眼略向内倾，黑瞳共望上方，留白如被咬去的小角。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Make two squat pebble-shaped eyes with blunt marker turns and slightly inward-leaning openings. Keep their sizes close. Large dark pupils glance upward together, almost touching both rims. Leave a broad irregular bite of paper near the upper side of each pupil instead of a round dot. Use a short disconnected lower mark on one eye and a continuous lower curve on the other. Keep the iris accent small and flat. Place only these two eyes on spacious paper.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
